verses.gurmukhi: ਵਣਵਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਇਕੋ ਧਰਤੀ ਇਕੋ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: vanavan vich vanaasapat iko dharatee iko paanee|

en.bdb: In all the forests vegetation is there and at all the places there is the same earth and the same water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ ਫੁਲ ਫਲ ਸਾਦ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)g bira(n)gee ful fal saadh suga(n)dh sanaba(n)dh viddaanee|

en.bdb: This sameness notwithstanding, the fragrance, taste and colour of fruits and flowers are wondrously different.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਚਾ ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਝੰਟੁਲਾ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਚੀਲ ਚੜ੍ਹੈ ਅਸਮਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: auchaa si(n)mal jha(n)Tulaa nihafal cheel chaRhai asamaanee|

en.bdb: The tall silk - cotton tree is of big expanse and fruitless chil tree touches the sky (these both like an egotist's person are proud of their size).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲਦਾ ਵਾਂਸੁ ਵਢਾਈਐ ਵੰਝੁਲੀਆਂ ਵਜਨਿ ਬੇਬਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jaladhaa vaa(n)s vaddaieeaai va(n)jhuleeaa(n) vajan bebaanee|

en.bdb: Bamboo keeps scorching thinking of its greatness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਰਵਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat vaas rahai niraga(n)dh ravaanee|

en.bdb: Sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant but bamboo remains devoid of fragrance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਅਭਾਗ ਪਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun ridhai na vasai abhaag paraanee|

en.bdb: Those who even listening to the word of Guru in the holy congregation do not adopt it in the heart are unfortunate.
They engrossed in ego and delusions go astray.
